summary.text: Paul Taylor is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran, he described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a nonprofit leader and community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Paul Taylor served in the U.S. Army from 1977 to 1997 and graduated from Apex Senior High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described his work as supporting youth programs, coordinating community initiatives and helping organizations expand their impact.
Taylor advanced to the general election after the Democratic primary was canceled.
In the survey, he said the policy areas he is most passionate about are public education, economics and health care.
